title: Ticket references
description: Tickets in other systems that the team keeps an eye on: incidents users reported through ServiceNow, and tickets with the vendors of the platforms and services we use. Steward only documents them – the ticket itself is handled where it lives.
deleteConfirm: Delete the ticket reference {{number}}? Its history is removed; the audit log keeps it.

hints.externalNumber: As in the other system, e.g. INC0012345 or the vendor's case number
hints.externalUrl: http(s) link to the ticket in the other system
hints.note: Short note in Markdown: what it is about, what was agreed
hints.vendor: Pick a vendor of an earlier entry or type a new one
hints.responsible: Steward users and teams who look after it. They may edit the entry and get the reminders.
hints.responsibleSelf: You edit this entry as one of the responsible people: keep yourself or your team in the list.
hints.statusComment: Shown in the history of the entry
hints.openedAt: When the ticket was opened in the other system

reminder.daysLabel: Remind after this many days without a check
reminder.summary_one: Reminds after {{count}} day without a check
reminder.summary_other: Reminds after {{count}} days without a check

detail.markdownSafe: The note is rendered as Markdown without HTML.

emptyState.title: No ticket references yet
emptyState.text: Note tickets here that matter for the service: an incident users reported in ServiceNow, or a case you opened with a vendor. Record who looks after it, link the affected services and platforms, and keep the status up to date.

emptyFiltered: No ticket references match the filters.

settings.title: Ticket references
settings.description: Sources of tickets and the default reminder. A source in use cannot be removed (rename it instead). Vendor sources count in the "open vendor tickets" badge of the service catalogue.
settings.label: Name
settings.reminderDefaultHint: Remind the responsible people when an open ticket was not checked for this many days. Entries can choose their own value or turn it off.
